root_idea.summary: The root is oriented toward nearness and relative proximity: one thing is nearer, lower, or adjacent to another.
root_idea.development: From this relational notion, the lexicon develops expressions for being below or less than a reference point, beside or apart from it, approaching it, and urging someone to take hold of or approach something. These root-level developments do not apply uniformly to every Quranic occurrence.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized citation form دُونَ; the Quranic nominal and adverbial uses are synthesized under one lexical headword.
The QAC locative-tagged occurrences are inflectional and syntactic uses of the same lexical item دُونَ, not a separate headword.

senses.definition: Other than, besides, apart from, or instead of.
senses.usage_conditions: Commonly used in constructions such as مِنْ دُونِ followed by a noun or pronoun, expressing exclusion, separation, or the selection of one thing instead of another. In some religious interpretations, the construction can describe entities regarded as means or intermediaries toward God; this is an interpretation of the relation, not a separate lexical sense.

senses.definition: Less than, below a specified amount, degree, or standard.
senses.usage_conditions: Used comparatively or with a stated reference point, including constructions equivalent to “what is less than that.” The Quranic alternatives “less than” and “other than” are related through the notion of falling short of or lying outside a stated limit.

senses.definition: Lower or inferior in rank, estimation, or condition than another.
senses.usage_conditions: May describe a party or person as below another in rank, religious standing, or another basis of comparison; it need not mean mere physical position.

senses.definition: Below, beneath, or beside a reference point.
senses.usage_conditions: A spatial or relational use, especially in constructions with مِنْ, locating something below or beside another party. The sense is distinct from general exclusion when the relation is primarily positional.

senses.definition: Before or prior to in time.
senses.usage_conditions: An adverbial use expressing precedence relative to a later event or stated reference.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become weak or low.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The derivation and usage are reported by some authorities; other authorities deny that this verb is properly derived from دُونَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Low, base, vile, inferior, paltry, scanty, or deficient.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival evaluation of a person or thing, including inferiority in an approvable quality or grounds for respect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Middling or intermediate in quality, between good and bad.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A value judgment describing something of moderate quality rather than distinctly good or bad.

other_classical_meanings.definition: High, eminent, noble, or honourable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A contrary value recorded in the Classical lexicon; the adjective can therefore have opposing evaluative applications depending on context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Before or in front of; also behind or beyond in spatial relation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reference point and direction determine whether the expression denotes the nearer/front side or what lies beyond it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Before or after in temporal relation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical usage with opposing temporal values reported according to context and interpretation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Nearer than another thing; to approach or draw near.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for relative proximity or for moving toward a person, place, or goal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To intervene between, obstruct, or prevent attainment of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The intervening thing stands between an agent and the object sought, thereby impeding access or achievement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Against, in the sense of intervening in defense of someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in protective constructions such as defending one's property, self, relative, or neighbour.

other_classical_meanings.definition: At, near, by, or present with.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational use indicating proximity or presence beside another party.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Take it; take hold of it; keep, cling to, or take care of someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An imperative or inciting expression, with the object stated directly or understood from context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A threat or warning to beware and engage at one's peril.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed inciting expression challenging or warning an addressee.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To write, compose, draw up, collect, or register; to establish or arrange registers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of compiling writings, instituting administrative registers, collecting books or poetry, and writing a person's name or information in a register.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become completely rich, wealthy, or competent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical usage reported as a dialectal or variant form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A register, account book, collection of written leaves, or book of records; also a collection of a poet's poetry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The register may concern accounts, soldiers, pensioners, administrators, or other official records; the word was also extended to books generally and especially collected poetry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The writers or registrars responsible for accounts or reckonings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A metonymic use derived from the register and its administration.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place of account or reckoning, including the office associated with its writers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A locational extension of the register sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A council, court, or tribunal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A later institutional use of the term for a governing or adjudicating body.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A long cushioned seat or settee arranged along the side of a room.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A later material and architectural use referring to the furnished seating arrangement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pertaining to or belonging to a register or administrative bureau.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational adjective derived from دِيوَانٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Lower or lesser of two matters.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative usage reported in a particular phrase and described by another authority as unusual because the underlying adjective was held not to have a verb.

cautions: دُونَ has Classical attestations with contrary evaluative values: lower or inferior, and in some usage higher or more eminent. The Quranic senses above are restricted to the usages supported for the relevant constructions.
The validity of the derived verbs دَانَ and أُدِينَ is disputed in the lexical evidence; the reported Classical meanings are retained without treating them as Quranic forms.
The Quran examples use only QAC-supplied modern locations; historical citation notation in the lexical evidence is not converted into additional modern verse locations.
